title: Print a left-aligned star triangle with 1 rows. (Challenge 1)
description: Print a left-aligned star triangle with 1 rows.
hints: Identify the main Python concept: pattern printing.
Write a small, direct solution and check indentation.
Compare each printed line with the expected output.
solution:
for row in range(1, 2):
    print("*" * row)
explanation: This exercise practices pattern printing. The solution uses the relevant Python feature and prints the required result.
commonMistakes: Forgetting correct indentation or punctuation.
Printing extra text that changes the expected output.
